{{Quote|During the relocation, Ziost was a thickly forested world, but it eventually yielded to an ice age that leveled the vast woodlands as well as most evidence of civilization.|An extract from [[Seviss Vaa]]'s account of the ice age on Ziost recorded in ''[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force]]''|<ref name="EGttF" />}}
Sometime after the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[invasion of Korriban]], an '''ice age''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], originally a thickly forested world with a [[Temperature/Legends|warm]] climate, that leveled the vast [[Forest/Legends|woodlands]] as well as most evidence of civilization. The towering [[Sith Citadel (Ziost)|Sith Citadel]] was among the few remaining structures following the devastation.<ref name="EGttF" />

By the time of [[Galactic War]], [[Scholar/Legends|scholars]] debated whether this environmental turnabout was due to an ice age or eons of dark side influence.<ref name="Codex" /> During the [[New Sith Wars]], [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] member [[Seviss Vaa]] researched the worlds of the Sith Empire, and mentioned the ice age in his recordings in the [[Telos Holocron]].<ref name="EGttF" />
